dedupe_keys.name: queens photovoltaic image and mask preparation code

description: The Queens photovoltaic-label team publishes Python utilities for working with its rooftop solar segmentation set. The README lists scripts that convert New York GIS JPEG2000 aerial imagery to PNG, transform JSON annotations into binary masks, and export annotations as Shapefiles. Source access is free under GPL 3.0. The utilities can prepare panel labels and images for detector evaluation before building distributed-solar inventories for simulation; data-global-power-plant-database is a related but larger-scale asset list. Coverage follows the 2018 Queens image layout, and other boroughs need coordinate and naming adjustments. A caveat is that converting annotations cannot improve uncertain labels or imply electrical capacity. The public README and licence were inspected, but the scripts were not run and no images or masks were downloaded. The labelled Zenodo dataset has different CC BY terms and is recorded separately.
